summary: Convolution reverb with zero latency: nine rooms of our own (small room, ambience, drum room, chamber, plate, hall, large hall, cathedral, tunnel: image-source early reflections, then a filtered-noise tail with its own decay in three bands) or any wave of the song as the room (mono or stereo, up to 10 s), with pre-delay, length (a trim with a fade), low and high cut, width, reverse, Mix, Amount (0 to 200 %) and Output. A new room is prepared in the background and crossfaded in over 50 ms. Use it for real-sounding space, or to put a sound into any recorded or made space; best on a send at 100% wet.
use_for: Convolution reverb with zero latency: nine rooms of our own or any wave of the song as the room, with pre-delay, length, low and high cut, width and reverse. Best on a send at 100% wet.

parameters.name: Room
parameters.description: The impulse response: one of nine rooms made by our own code, or Wave (the song's wave in the Wave slot)
parameters.how: Chooses the room: nine built-in rooms from a small room to a cathedral and a tunnel, or Wave, which uses a wave of the song as the room.
parameters.sound: Small rooms add closeness, a chamber or a hall add depth, a plate is bright and dense, a cathedral and a tunnel ring for seconds, and a wave puts the sound inside that wave.

parameters.name: Wave
parameters.description: The wave slot (1 to 200) used when Room is Wave; the song saves the wave, this only names its slot
parameters.how: Picks the slot of the song's wavetable that is the room when Room is Wave, from 1 to 200.
parameters.sound: Any recording works as a room: a clap or a burst of noise gives a natural space, a drone or a voice gives a strange, coloured wash. An empty slot falls back to the hall.

parameters.name: Pre-delay
parameters.description: Silence before the reverb starts (the response's first reflection arrives this late)
parameters.how: Sets the gap before the reverb starts, from 0 to 250 ms.
parameters.sound: A longer gap keeps the dry sound clear in front of the reverb and adds a sense of distance.

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: How much of the response is used: the rest is cut with a fade
parameters.how: Sets how much of the room's response is kept, from 5 to 100 %; the end is faded out so the cut cannot click.
parameters.sound: Shorter values cut the tail and make the room smaller and tighter, 100 % keeps the whole natural decay.

parameters.name: Low cut
parameters.description: High-pass on the response (12 dB/oct, twice); at its lowest it is off
parameters.how: Removes low frequencies from the reverb, from 20 Hz to 1 kHz; the lowest setting is off.
parameters.sound: Raising it keeps the reverb from muddying the bass and thins it out.

parameters.name: High cut
parameters.description: Low-pass on the response (12 dB/oct, twice); at its highest it is off
parameters.how: Rolls off high frequencies of the reverb, from 1 to 20 kHz; the highest setting is off.
parameters.sound: Lowering it darkens the reverb so it sits further behind the dry sound.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Stereo width of the response: 0 is mono, 100 % as it is, 200 % twice the side
parameters.how: Sets the stereo width of the reverb, from 0 % (mono) to 200 %.
parameters.sound: Low widths focus the reverb in the middle, high widths spread it far past the speakers.

parameters.name: Reverse
parameters.description: Plays the response backwards: the tail swells up into the sound
parameters.sound: The reverb builds up from nothing and stops at its loudest point, like a swell that pulls back into the note.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Dry/wet (100 % for a send); the dry sound is never delayed
parameters.how: Blends the dry sound with the reverb from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Use a low value as an insert, or 100 % when the reverb sits on a send.

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: Effect strength: 100 % = the settings as shown, 0 % = bypass (bit for bit the input), 200 % = twice the wet level
parameters.how: Scales how much reverb there is: the wet level goes with Amount (and the dry level makes room for it up to 100 %). 0 % is bypass, 100 % your settings, 200 % doubles the wet level (6 dB more).
parameters.sound: Turn it down to hear the room fade away, up to push the reverb further forward.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Level of the reverb (the wet signal)
parameters.how: Sets the level of the reverb in dB, from -24 to +24.
parameters.sound: It makes the reverb louder or quieter without changing the room.
